changelog: **Canonical skill taxonomy — schema and resolver (#1815, epic #1810):** five new tables, all additive (`CREATE TABLE` + foreign keys only; `User.skills`, `User.skillLevels` and `Requisition.requiredSkills` are untouched): `Skill` (org-scoped, `@@unique([orgId, key])`, EN/TR/DE labels, `status` ACTIVE/RETIRED, `mergedIntoId` self-relation so a merged skill keeps resolving), `SkillAlias` (folded spellings, unique per org), `SkillEdge` (weighted ADJACENT/BROADER/NARROWER), `UserSkill` and `RequisitionSkill`. `Skill`, `SkillAlias` and `SkillEdge` are registered in `TENANT_MODELS`; the two join tables are reached through scoped parents like `UserTag`. The pure rules (caps, labels, keys, cycle-safe merge-chain and adjacency walks) live in `src/lib/skillTaxonomyRule.ts` (unit-tested, coverage floor 95); `src/lib/skillsResolve.ts` adds `resolveSkill` / `resolveMany` (key → alias → merge chain, through the existing `skillKey()` fold), `expandAdjacent` and the idempotent `seedSkillTaxonomy(orgId)` that turns the #1816 starter vocabulary into rows. Nothing reads the tables yet — the picker, backfill and filters are #1818/#1819/#1820. Design notes: `docs/skill-taxonomy.md`.
